T: Stew from a cyborg. Treasure from a planet.
D: A teenage space surfer finds a map to a legendary treasure and signs on as cabin boy aboard a solar galleon.
P: Serve the mains when Silver serves up his stew in the ship's galley.
S: Ham and cheese puff pastry triangles
Puff pastry parcels filled with ham and cheddar
Puff pastry squares filled with ham and cheddar, folded, egg washed and baked at 200C for 15 minutes until golden.
Purple plums, figs and red grapes with honey and lime
Purple plums, red grapes and figs cut and piled on a platter, with a little honey and lime.

Cream cheese and cheddar mixed and rolled into all sorts of little shapes, coated in paprika or chives, served with crackers. Beat 250g softened cream cheese with 150g finely grated vintage cheddar, 1 small grated garlic clove and a pinch of cayenne. Chill 30 minutes until firm. Roll teaspoons of the mix into balls, logs and little blob shapes. Roll some in smoked paprika, some in chopped chives and some in crushed toasted pecans. Chill 15 minutes more and serve with 200g crackers and celery sticks.
M: Beef chuck stewed with onions, carrots, stout and potatoes
Beef chuck browned and simmered 3 hours with onion, carrots, potatoes and stout until thick, served in bowls with crusty bread.

Egg noodles stir-fried with chicken, capsicum and broccoli in a sticky soy and honey sauce. Slice 500g chicken thigh and toss with 1 tbsp soy and 1 tsp cornflour. Loosen 400g fresh egg noodles in hot water. Mix 3 tbsp soy, 2 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp oyster sauce and 1 tsp sesame oil. Stir-fry the chicken in a very hot wok with oil for 4 minutes and set aside. Stir-fry 1 sliced red capsicum, 1 head broccoli in small florets and 2 garlic cloves for 3 minutes. Add the noodles, chicken and sauce and toss until sticky. Top with sesame seeds.
W: Fudgy dark chocolate brownies cut into rectangles
Fudgy brownies baked at 170C for 25 minutes, cut into chests, topped with chocolate coins.
K: Blueberry syrup and lime over ice, topped with fizz

Blueberries simmered into a quick syrup with lime, poured over ice and topped with lemonade so it fades from deep purple to starry blue. Simmer 150g blueberries with 50g caster sugar and 60ml water for 5 minutes, crushing the berries, then strain and cool. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice and a few fresh blueberries. Add the juice of half a lime to each, then pour 600ml cold lemonade between them. Slowly spoon the blueberry syrup over the top so it sinks through the glass in layers. Stir at the table.

dishes.n: Ham and cheese puff pastry triangles
dishes.make_ahead: Fill, fold and press the triangles up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; brush with egg and bake on the night

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C. Cut the pastry into squares and grate the cheese.
Fill each with ham and cheddar, fold into triangles and press the edges with a fork.
Brush with beaten egg.
Bake until golden.

veg.n: Spinach and cheese puff pastry triangles
veg.make_ahead: Wilt, cool and squeeze the spinach up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; fill, glaze and bake on the night

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C. Wilt the spinach in a dry pan, cool and squeeze out the water.
Cut the pastry into squares and grate the cheese.
Fill each with spinach and cheddar, fold into triangles and press the edges with a fork.
Brush with beaten egg.
Bake until golden.

s.n: Ham and cheese puff pastry triangles
s.note: Puff pastry parcels filled with ham and cheddar
s.how: Cut 2 sheets of puff pastry into squares. Fill each with ham and grated cheddar, fold into triangles and press the edges with a fork. Brush with beaten egg and bake at 200C for 15 minutes until golden. Serve warm at the inn.

s.note: Purple plums, figs and red grapes with honey and lime
s.how: Halve 4 purple plums and 4 fresh figs and pile on a platter with bunches of red grapes. Drizzle with honey and squeeze over a little lime juice. Serve straight away, the closest thing on Earth to a purp.

m.note: Beef chuck stewed with onions, carrots, stout and potatoes
m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck, then add 2 onions, 3 carrots and 375ml stout with water to cover. Simmer 2 hours, add 600g potato chunks and simmer another hour until thick. Serve in bowls with crusty bread, ship's cook style.

w.note: Fudgy dark chocolate brownies cut into rectangles
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 150g butter. Whisk in 250g sugar and 3 eggs, then fold in 100g flour. Bake at 170C for 25 minutes and cool. Cut into rectangles like chests and pile gold chocolate coins on top.

d.note: Blueberry syrup and lime over ice, topped with fizz
d.how: Simmer 150g blueberries with 50g caster sugar and 60ml water for 5 minutes, crushing the berries, then strain and cool. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice and a few fresh blueberries. Add the juice of half a lime to each, then pour 600ml cold lemonade between them. Slowly spoon the blueberry syrup over the top so it sinks through the glass in layers. Stir at the table.
